definition: A reusable arrangement without independent adoption or semantic ownership.
Typed behavior required or offered by products and implementations.
A subsystem that lacks its own complete adoption/support/exit promise.
A provider artifact or adapter that may offer capabilities but owns no canonical meaning.
A reusable pure or explicitly effect-bounded implementation seam.
A separate bounded context imported through an explicit contract.
An independently adopted and operated outcome promise.
Owner of a meaning, lifecycle, invariants and refusals.
An exact external edition specializing a contract.
Packaging of products and capabilities without transferred meaning.
